citations.locator: United Church of Christ, group profile
citations.excerpt: The United Church of Christ was founded in 1957 as a merger of the Congregational-Christian Churches and the Evangelical and Reformed Church.
It continues the American Congregational tradition.

facts.value: Created in 1957 by a union of the Evangelical and Reformed Church with the Congregational Christian Churches, themselves a 1931 union. Its roots include English Congregationalism and German Lutheran and Reformed traditions.

citations.excerpt: Its roots grew out of German Lutheranism, German and Swiss Reformed traditions, Anabaptist Christian Church traditions, and English Congregationalism.
The Congregational Churches and the Christian Church came together in 1931 to become the Congregational Christian Churches.
